description: Record the buyer's inspection of a placed order: for each item (its index in terms.items) the quantity accepted and the quantity rejected, with a reason for a rejection, optionally for one portion of the order. Whether it was accepted is computed: only when nothing is rejected. Recorded for the business, which answers a rejection in inspect_offer thread.fulfilment, with a proposed remedy. Nothing here pays or refunds.

id.description: The request or offer id from your receipt or customer link

name.description: Name of the person making this for the buyer

portion.description: The portion inspected, as thread.fulfilment.portions names it

terms_sha256.description: Exact terms_sha256 from inspect_offer; the act is refused if the terms have changed since

token.description: Private token from your receipt or customer link; keep it for later visits

name: inspect_delivery
title: Record a delivery inspection
